name: hotel-booking-api

dependencies.name: internal-payments-api
dependencies.description: Charges the traveler at booking time and refunds them on cancellation.

description: Owns the hotel/room catalog and the traveler's bookings. Exposes search over hotels and rooms, and create/list/cancel for the caller's own bookings, charging and refunding through the internal payments API. Does not manage hotel inventory (no admin surface) and holds no conversation state — that belongs to hotel-booking-agent.
